claim: The affine seam pair {0000,1111} is not closed under the full genus-two modular characteristic action; its full orbit contains all ten even characteristics, while the pair closes under a finite order-16 setwise stabilizer. The seam toggle also changes separating vanishing order from zero to one.
status: exact finite characteristic-orbit and separating-parity calculation; theta multipliers and a full partition function remain open

separatingDegeneration.meaning: The seam toggle changes zero-mode/factorization content; it is not multiplication of one nonzero scalar block by an orientation sign.

allowedCompletions: Restrict to the inverse image in Sp(4,Z) of the order-16 pair stabilizer, interpreting the seam as marked level/defect data.
Enlarge the modular object to at least the full ten-component even-characteristic orbit and solve the theta-multiplier/GSO phase problem.
Use a vector-valued modular form or defect category in which the seam pair is one local chart rather than the whole state space.
ruledOut: A globally scalar, full-Sp(4,Z)-covariant theory made only from the two seam characteristics.
Interpreting the seam toggle as only an orientation sign with unchanged separating zero modes.
boundary: Closure of the ten characteristic labels is necessary but not sufficient for a modular partition function; automorphy multipliers, powers, phases, positivity and sewing must still be supplied.
